movelist.name: Endeavor
movelist.effect: The target loses a Tick of Hit Points for each Injury the user has.

movelist.name: Soak
movelist.effect: The target gains the Water Type in addition to its other Types for 5 turns.

movelist.name: Beat Up
movelist.effect: The user and up to two allies adjacent to the target may each make a Struggle Attack against the target. These Struggle Attacks hit for Dark-Type Damage instead of their usual Type. Beat Up may trigger Pack Hunt only once, no matter the number of attacks.

abilities.name: Schooling
abilities.effect: The user changes to Schooling Forme, and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half of its own maximum Hit Points. The user cannot gain Temporary Hit Points from other sources while in Schooling Forme. When the user is below half Maximum HP and has no Temporary Hit Points left, they change back into Solo Forme.

abilities.name: Horde Break
abilities.trigger: The user changes from School Form to Solo Form
abilities.effect: The user is cured of all Status Conditions.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.effect: While at full Hit Points, all damage taken is resisted one step further. Defensive.
